meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你排查容器化 agent 的故障:查看宿主日志与容器 stderr、检查会话数据库里的消息流、核对挂载与心跳文件,并顺着常见问题给出定位步骤和修复命令。
howto.when: 当容器跑不起来、消息没有回复、出现认证报错,或你想弄清容器系统怎么运作时,它会接管排查。

say.text: 容器没回复了,帮我看看哪一步断的
say.note: 会检查会话 DB 与宿主日志

say.text: 帮我查 logs/nanoclaw.error.log 里的报错
say.note: 从宿主错误日志开始定位

say.text: 怀疑有两个服务实例在同时跑,帮我确认
say.note: 对应消息静默丢失的常见原因

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps troubleshoot the containerized agent system: it reads host logs and container stderr, inspects the message flow in the session DBs, checks mounts and heartbeats, and traces common issues to a fix.
howto.when_en: It takes over when containers fail to start, replies go missing, authentication errors appear, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container stopped replying — find where it broke
say_en.note: Checks the session DBs and host log

say_en.text: Look at the errors in logs/nanoclaw.error.log
say_en.note: Starts from the host error log

say_en.text: I suspect two service instances are running
say_en.note: A common cause of silently lost messages
